08Th October, 2025
 Second Anticipatory Bail Application No.42 of 2025
Sushil Kumar Ghod .....Applicant
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand .....Respondent

Counsel for the Applicant : Mrs. Prabha Naithani,
 Advocate.
Counsel for the Respondent : Mr. Akshay Latwal,

Assistant Government  Advocate assisted by  Mr. Prabhat Kandpal,
 Brief Holder.
Hon'ble Alok Kumar Verma,J.

The present Application has been filed by the applicant-Sushil Kumar Ghod seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.20 of 2025, registered at Police Station Rajpur, District Dehradun under Sections 120B, 420, 467, 468 and Section 471 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860.
2.
The First Anticipatory Bail Application (No.196 of 2025) was dismissed on 18.07.2025 for want of prosecution.
3. Supplementary affidavit dated 25.09.2025 of the applicant is taken on record.

4. Heard Mrs. Prabha Naithani, learned counsel for the applicant and Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned Assistant Government Advocate for the respondent.
5.
Mrs. Prabha Naithani, Advocate, submitted that due to miscommunication, the learned counsel for the applicant could not appear on 18.07.2025.

sentences.text: According to the First Information Report, the applicant executed a forged registered sale-deed in favor of the co-accused Surya Prakash Soni on 23.03.2024.
7. Mrs. Prabha Naithani, Advocate, submitted that the owner of the property-in-question was late Arvind Kumar Ghod and the present applicant is his son.
Applicant was the sole owner of the property-in-question.
8. Mr. Akshay Latwal, learned Assistant Government Advocate, has sought three weeks' time to file objection to the Anticipatory Bail Application.
9. Time is granted.

10. Having heard the submissions of learned counsel for the parties and in the facts and circumstances of the case, as an ad-interim measure, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the applicant Sushil Kumar Ghod, he shall be released on interim bail on executing a personal bond of Rs.30,000/- and two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Investigating Officer/ Arresting Officer, subject to the following conditions:-
(i) Applicant shall cooperate with the Investigating Agency and he shall make himself available for interrogation by a police officer as and when required;
(ii) Applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of this case.
(iii) Applicant shall not leave the country without the previous permission of this Court.
11. List on 12.11.2025 for hearing on the Anticipatory Bail Application.
___________________ ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
